# Pinecone Standard Plan Storage Cost for 10 GB

## Summary
Pinecone’s official pricing page lists the Standard plan storage rate at **$0.33 per GB per month** [1]. Multiplying this rate by 10 GB gives a monthly cost of **$3.30** [1]. Thus, 10 GB of storage on the Standard plan would cost **$3.30 per month**.

## Cost Calculation

| Item | Value | Source |
|------|-------|--------|
| Storage rate (Standard plan) | $0.33 / GB / month | [1] |
| Storage amount | 10 GB | — |
| Monthly cost | 10 GB × $0.33 / GB = $3.30 | [1] |

The multiplication was verified using the calculator tool, confirming the result of $3.30.

## Limitations
No additional pricing tiers, discounts, or volume‑based adjustments were found on the official Pinecone pricing page that would alter the 10 GB calculation.
